name: DisProt_search
description: Search DisProt for intrinsically disordered proteins by gene name, protein-name fragment, organism, DisProt ID or UniProt accession (case-insensitive substring match on gene, then protein name; organism is tried only when neither matches). Free-text keywords such as 'phase separation' are not supported by DisProt and return no hits. DisProt is a manually curated database providing experimentally validated disorder annotations with evidence codes and literature references. Returns DisProt ID, UniProt accession, protein name, organism, disorder content fraction, and number of annotated regions. Useful for finding disordered proteins in a specific pathway or organism. Example: searching 'TP53' returns DP00086 (p53, 37.7% disorder, 63 regions); searching 'amyloid' returns proteins with 'amyloid' in their name (e.g. amyloid-beta precursor protein, serum amyloid A). Results are paginated: metadata reports total_matches_by_filter, has_more and next_page (pass it as page); with more than one filter queried, total_results is an upper bound (total_results_is_exact false).

query.description: Gene name (e.g., 'TP53'), protein-name fragment (e.g., 'kinase', 'amyloid'), organism (e.g., 'Saccharomyces'), DisProt ID (e.g., 'DP00086') or UniProt accession (e.g., 'P04637'). Not a free-text keyword search.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (default 10, ToolUniverse safety maximum 500). The DisProt API documents page_size without an upstream maximum.

page.description: Zero-based result page. Use metadata.next_page to continue. Default: 0.

gene.description: Gene symbol -- the FIRST name on the entry; read gene_names for all of them

gene_names.description: Every gene name on the entry. Both handlers took genes[0] with no count: P0DN86 is CGB3, CGB5 and CGB8, so a caller searching for CGB8 was answered CGB3.

gene_count.description: How many gene names the entry carries.

matched_on.description: Which field this hit matched on -- gene, protein name or organism -- since the three are queried in turn.

disorder_content.description: Fraction of sequence that is disordered (0-1)

name: DisProt_get_entry
description: Get detailed disorder region annotations for a protein from DisProt. Accepts either a DisProt ID or UniProt accession. Regions use explicit offset/limit pagination; response metadata reports the exact returned and total region counts, whether more regions exist, and the next offset. Every region retains all returned cross-references.

accession.description: DisProt ID (e.g., 'DP00086') or UniProt accession (e.g., 'P04637'). Both formats accepted.

region_offset.description: Zero-based offset within the entry's disorder regions. Default: 0.

region_limit.description: Maximum disorder regions returned per call. Default: 30. Use metadata.next_region_offset to continue.

gene.description: The FIRST gene name on the entry; read gene_names for all of them

gene_names.description: Every gene name on the entry. Both handlers took genes[0] with no count: P0DN86 is CGB3, CGB5 and CGB8, so a caller searching for CGB8 was answered CGB3.

gene_count.description: How many gene names the entry carries.

term_id.description: Ontology identifier of the annotated term, e.g. GO:0005515 for protein binding or IDPO:00076 for disorder.

term_ontology.description: Ontology the term_id belongs to (GO, IDPO).

evidence_code_id.description: The ECO identifier, e.g. ECO:0006165. evidence_code carries its sentence-long name; this is what a caller joins or cites.

evidence_code_go.description: The GO evidence code the ECO term maps to, e.g. EXP.

statements.description: The curator's quoted evidence for this annotation: the sentence from the paper the annotation rests on, typed by the section it came from. The term name says 'protein binding'; the statement says what was shown. All 63 of P04637's regions carry one. Text over STATEMENT_CHARACTERS is cut and text_truncated says so.

type.description: Section of the paper: Introduction, Methods, Results.

text_truncated.description: True when the quote was cut.

interaction_partners.description: The molecules a binding region binds. 26 of P04637's 63 regions are annotated 'protein binding' and the partner is the content of that annotation: one such region binds UniProt P32776. Empty for regions that are not binding annotations.

database.description: Database of the partner id, e.g. UniProt.

partner_start.description: Start of the partner's own region, where DisProt records one.

partner_end.description: End of the partner's own region.

reference_id.description: Identifier of the paper the annotation came from, in the namespace reference_source names -- a PubMed id for every P04637 region.

reference_source.description: Namespace of reference_id, e.g. pmid, doi.

reference.description: The citation as DisProt renders it (title, authors, journal, year), with HTML emphasis tags as sent.

disprot_namespace.description: DisProt's own grouping for the term: 'Structural state', 'Structural transition', 'Interaction partner', 'Function'.
